releaseNotes: Workbook Audit: Go to Cell no longer shrinks a maximized Excel window - navigation now preserves the window state and geometry exactly
Go to Cell on a hidden sheet records the temporary unhide in the status line and the audit log so it can be restored

Workbook Audit acceptance harness: the QA challenge workbook is now a committed CI fixture proving detection, actionability, repair, re-audit, verification, undo and unrelated-change checks for every finding type

New previewed repairs: restore pattern formulas (the preview states the evaluated result), convert unambiguous ISO dates to real dates, apply the column's dominant number format, delete the later of two identical rows, unmerge record-bridging merges
Identifier safety: 13+-digit numeric text and leading-zero codes are never auto-converted - the refusal reason is stated on the disabled action
External workbook dependencies now carry Keep / Relink / Break guidance; breaking stays in Excel's Edit Links dialog, never automatic
Grouped volatile-formula findings navigate to their first cell; every fix runs the full validate, backup, confirm, apply, journal, verify, undo pipeline
